settings.ota_help: Choose a SilbapRemoteStick .bin file. The stick restarts into the new firmware when the upload finishes; if it does not come up healthy, it rolls back by itself.

settings.ota_armed: Allowed. Short-press BOOT now, then press Upload within 30 seconds.
settings.ota_done: Firmware written. The stick is restarting; this page will reconnect in about 30 seconds.
settings.ota_started: Started. Do not close this page.
err.ota_arm: The update is not allowed: press BOOT within 30 seconds of allowing it.
err.wrong_image: That file is not SilbapRemoteStick firmware.
err.ota_busy: The machine is reading the disk. Try again in a few seconds.
help.title: Help
err.bad_password: The password must be at most 64 bytes.
err.bad_wifi: Needs a network name (up to 32 bytes) and a password of 8 to 64 characters (or none).
